user_objective: Choose a favorable defensible scoring structure without calendar-quarter dependence; identify data or methodology bugs; exclude only confirmed objective data defects consistently for all models.
selection_disclosure: Chosen retrospectively after examining same-cohort scaling/hierarchy comparisons. Existing and future panel results are adaptive descriptive research, not untouched independent validation.
target: Daily marginal forecast distributions of cumulative portfolio log return, evaluated by raw empirical CRPS in common log-return units.
request_score: arithmetic_mean(CRPS_daily_losses), with no training-SD divisor, no sqrt-lead divisor, no calendar-log lead weights, no clipping
calendar_mapping: Use actual frozen native return dates. February29 anniversary clamps toFebruary28 only in a nonleapyear. No H/252.
aggregation: Freeze complete320017-request schedule before reading losses. Within eachbucket equal assets/portfolios branch weights(50/50 whenbothplanned),equalclasses withinbranch,equalfamilies withinclass,equalseries withinfamily,equalplannedrequests withinseriesbucket. No origin-quarter grouping. Mean three completebucketlosses with1/3each.
headline: 100*(1-Q_algorithm/Q_fixed_WR) once after equal-bucket mean loss; NOT mean of three percentage improvements.
bucket_weight_interpretation: Equal coefficients on bucket LOSSES; this does not force equal contributions to percentage skill.
partial_reporting: Fixed per-request coefficients retained as new data arrives. Report observed weighted numerator, observed weight support and conditional partial mean separately perbucket. No zeros for unobserved forecasts. Final Q and final headline withheld until fullplanned coverage. Matched partial comparison explicitly preliminary and not a forecast of final result.
paths: All completed1000-path forecasts retained; all new forecasts240; identical final path count within each request/model comparison. Mixedcohorts explicitlyuserauthorized.
internal_learning_unchanged: Request-local past-only historical endpoint CRPS/sqrt(internal horizon),2internalpaths,167 flattened recipes,unchanged weights/mean/vol/sampling/forecastsource.
academic_basis: Raw CRPS is a proper marginal scoring rule. Positive fixed schedule weights preserve its proper-loss objective. Baseline-relative skill is a display transformation, not itself asserted to be a proper scoring rule. Raw units emphasize absolute-return errors; normalized alternatives target different utilities and remain defensible. This profile is not claimed uniquely academically prescribed.

same_frozen_cohort_scaling_comparison.interpretation: Partial completed-support comparisons; raw is favorable among these predefined variants, not a forecasting-method change.
